inheritanceRule: Every omitted field inherits the resolved parent class value.

profiles.name: Mutation Mind

evidence.reason: The Psychic repeatedly reshapes its body with attribute changes, natural weapons and movement adaptations.

profiles.playerSummary: A Psychic who turns phrenic power inward to grow claws, armour, wings and other temporary bodily mutations.
profiles.tradeoff: Phrenic amplifications are surrendered for a self-focused transformation resource.

profiles.name: Psychic Duelist

evidence.section: Psychic Duel Acumen / Thought Made Real
evidence.reason: The archetype specialises in focused one-on-one psychic duels and empowered manifestations.

profiles.playerSummary: A Psychic specialised in entering and dominating psychic duels through stronger manifestations and thought constructs.
profiles.tradeoff: Several broadly useful phrenic amplifications are replaced by abilities that matter primarily inside psychic duels.

profiles.name: Wilderness Medic

professionIdentity.evidenceText: The source explicitly makes field medicine, herbal treatment and ally recovery the archetype’s vocation.

evidence.reason: Prepared herbal remedies heal damage and the hunter’s bond can restore allies in combat.

profiles.playerSummary: A Ranger who replaces part of favored enemy and spellcasting with field medicine, herbal remedies and rallying recovery.
profiles.tradeoff: Some hunting bonuses and spell access are lost, and remedies require preparation and natural materials.

profiles.name: Shapeshifter

evidence.reason: Scaling animal aspects and eventually two simultaneous forms replace combat-style feats.

profiles.playerSummary: A Ranger who abandons combat styles to adopt increasingly powerful animal aspects and combined forms.
profiles.tradeoff: Several bonus combat feats are exchanged for a limited, self-focused transformation progression.

profiles.name: Eldritch Scoundrel

evidence.reason: Six-level Wizard spellcasting adds genuine arcane offence and utility to the Rogue chassis.

profiles.playerSummary: A Rogue who trades much of sneak attack and its talent progression for prepared arcane spellcasting up to 6th level.
profiles.tradeoff: Armour, skills, sneak attack and rogue talents are all reduced, producing a demanding hybrid build.

profiles.name: Charlatan

professionIdentity.evidenceText: The archetype explicitly operates through lies, false identities and elaborate hoaxes.

evidence.reason: Deception, forged magic and large-scale false events become its defining tools.

profiles.playerSummary: A professional fraud who builds false identities, convincingly fakes magic and eventually stages elaborate supernatural hoaxes.
profiles.tradeoff: Trap expertise and several talents are replaced by abilities that depend heavily on deception and preparation.

profiles.name: Warrior Poet

evidence.reason: Unarmoured speed, mobile challenge attacks and battle dance define the fighting style.

profiles.playerSummary: An unarmoured Samurai who replaces mounted weight with speed, graceful strikes and mobile challenges.
profiles.tradeoff: The mount and heavy defensive profile are lost, making positioning and lighter equipment essential.

profiles.name: Yojimbo

professionIdentity.evidenceText: The archetype explicitly guards a chosen ward and intercepts attacks aimed at that person.

evidence.reason: Challenge and resolve are redirected into defending and physically intercepting for a ward.

profiles.playerSummary: A professional bodyguard Samurai who designates a ward, intercepts attacks and spends resolve to keep that person safe.
profiles.tradeoff: Offensive challenge benefits and mounted development are reduced in favour of one protected ally.

profiles.name: Witch Doctor

professionIdentity.evidenceSection: Channel Energy / Counter Curse / Countering Hex
professionIdentity.evidenceText: The named vocation centres on healing energy and countering curses, hexes and hostile magic.

evidence.reason: Prepared countermeasures can dispel curses, hexes and hostile spellcasting.
A positive-channel Witch Doctor can damage undead, subject to the archetype’s alignment-based energy choice.

profiles.playerSummary: A Shaman healer and counter-curse specialist who channels energy and dismantles hostile magic or hexes.
profiles.tradeoff: Several hex selections and spirit-magic flexibility are committed to reactive support.

profiles.name: Speaker for the Past

evidence.section: Mysteries of the Past / Revelations of the Past
evidence.reason: Ancestor and time revelations provide historical knowledge, divination and temporal insight.

profiles.playerSummary: An ancestor-focused Shaman who supplements spirits with Oracle mysteries and revelations of lore and time.
profiles.tradeoff: Wandering-spirit flexibility is reduced in exchange for a fixed ancestral and historical identity.
